title: Voice dialogs: Added option to use or ignore display filter in VoIP/RTP dialogs
description:
VoIP Calls dialog and RTP Streams dialog has now option to apply display
filter dialog during processing packets.
Filter checkbox is activated during dialog open when display filter is active.

New field apply_display_filter had to be added to voip_calls_tapinfo_t and
_rtpstream_tapinfo/rtpstream_tapinfo_t structures.

notes.body:
added 12 commits
  • cc4e8f3a...1f3a81de - 11 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 2a5c96a7 - Voice dialogs: Added option to apply display filter in VoIP/RTP dialogs
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1549/diffs?diff_id=133718438&start_sha=cc4e8f3a50085153b2bde7b4a81ccfe9ddebf1ec)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 2a5c96a79948d2f77cb48e048d6c6eba5c835f98 succeeds

@j.novak - Using git bisect, commit 2a5c96a799 has introduced a regression that will trigger a segfault whenever one tries to open the VoIP Calls dialog (Telephony -> VoIP Calls), the RTP Streams dialog (Telephony -> RTP -> RTP Streams), or the SIP Flows dialog (Telephony -> SIP Flows) when there is no capture file open.  Prior to this commit these dialogs would open but present the text [no capture file] in the dialog title.
Thank you for notification, I'm checking it.
